text_block_list.text:
The day of the Big Bang Idol Fest had arrived!
As for Hokko Tarumae—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
......I'm fine.
I can do this, I will do this, it's possible.
I can do this, I will do this, it's possible—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...It's a bit different from a post-race Winning Live,
and it's my first time performing in such a massive venue
as a local idol, after all..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Kh, someone's calling—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Tarumaeee! Do your best today!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ricky!?
Wait, where you're standing...
Are you actually at the venue right now!?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
There's no waaaay I wouldn't come cheer for you☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I'm here too~.
Do your best, Tarumae-chan~.
Push, push~."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "Ah, even Ms. Acute...!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Aaaand next! I'm here too!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeppers☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "Falco-san!? Why!?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehe☆ I mean, to begin with,
I just love this "Big Bang Idol Fest" and go every year♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: “—Tarumae-chan! Shine bright today and aim for center stage in the encore!”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Please watch.
This is the culmination of everything local idol Hokko Tarumae has done up until today!

text_block_list.name: Main MC
text_block_list.text:
Up next is—!!
The sensational active dirt Umamusume local idol!!
Tomakomai's Tourism Ambassador, Hokko Tarumae~~!
(WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Incredible...! In such a huge venue,
with so many people...! But—)

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-chaaaann!!
Do your beeeest!!!

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-e-e-e-e!!!
You're shining bright today too-o-o!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(I can hear everyone's voices...!
So I'm not scared of anything...!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—A migratory bird with wings of paper,
soaring in from the Port of Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Surf clam lover☆
Tomakomai's local idol, Hokko Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...I've prepared a new song for today.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"This song is...
a song I made together with everyone in Tomakomai."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It is filled with memories... with all the bonds
between me and Tomakomai up until today.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Please listen!
"SHINE! YOUR/MY STAR!"!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...I'll shine right here and now, like a star♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: There are sights I can always look back on♪

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Citizen
text_block_list.text: (—I still remember it so well, Tarumae-chan, seeing you waving so energetically and calling out to the ships!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: There's a smile I'll remember forever♪

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text: (—I still look at the photos from when you first started out as a local idol sometimes, Tarumae-chan.)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That warmth, that gentleness♪
has always watched over me, hasn't it?♪

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Shopping District Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: (—I still look back fondly on how hard Tarumae-chan worked for our shop back then.)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (My love for Tomakomai, and the warmth that Tomakomai gave to me—)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(The Tomakomai I've seen,
and the me that Tomakomai has watched over—)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (I borrowed words and memories from everyone in Tomakomai and poured every bit of it into these lyrics...!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Right here, right now, I'll shine as a star♪
Right here, right now, I'll sparkle, beyond that sky♪

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, she started running across the stage!?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's always right here♪ I want to return this warmth♪
I'll forever share♪ The hometown I love so much♪

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Her voice carries so well
even while running that hard, that's insane...!
And her smile is great...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(What Tomakomai means to me, and what I mean to Tomakomai...
I'll convey all of it through this song—)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
“—With my very own light♪ With the light you gave to me♪
Turning our bonds into wings♪ Now, I'll take flight♪”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: SHINE! YOUR/MY STAR!

text_block_list.name: Main MC
text_block_list.text:
—That was a wonderful song that really touched our hearts...!
Hokko Tarumae-san,
please give us your closing remarks!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...As the star raised by Tomakomai,
I'll keep shining brightly—in my races
and as a local idol!!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Please give your support to me and my hometown of Tomakomai!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"It's kind of... how should I put it...
It's strange, but I think... maybe I miss home a little...—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That was such a straightforward, great song!
Still, Tomakomai, huh...
Maybe I'll make Tomakomai my next travel destination.
And the Big Bang Idol Fest flew by in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: “—Tarumae-chan, congrats on winning the Special Tournament Award~~~~~!!! Cheeeeers!!!”

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: Cheeeeeeeers!!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That was a fantastic stage, Tarumae!
The feng shui elements came together so well, it was the best!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not actually using feng shui, okay?!
W-Well, thank you so much for cheering for me, though!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I had a lot of fun too~.
Everyone was so hyped up,
and I got to flap my arms around a whole bunch.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm so glad Acute-san
got to enjoy herself a lot too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Tarumae-chan, you're really amazing!
I mean, they don't even give out the 'Special Tournament Award' every year, you know?!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It looks that way. I heard it's awarded regardless of vote count
to whichever performance left the strongest impression on the tournament.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! Tarumae-chan was shining so brightly while singing that song! I could totally feel all that hometown love!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. But... it's so frustrating
that I couldn't stand on the encore stage
I was aiming for...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...At today's festival, Tarumae-chan's stage
was my absolute favorite!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Watching it made me
waaaaant to do a live show so badly too!
So—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-chan, thank you!
For letting me see today's stage!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (...I wonder if I managed to repay them, even just a little.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: —Still, Tarumae is really greedy, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: G-Greedy!? How on earth am I greedy!?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I mean, you're trying to reach incredible heights in both racing and as a local idol, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Chasing two hares" and all that—
personally, I think it's pretty greedy~.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even if you tell me that!
Because it's my dream—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
I think it looks cool!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
To make both of those things a success, Tarumae steadily built up her efforts and delivered results.
That's really cool, and—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: That's exactly why I want to chase after them!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"...At the end of the year,
I'm going to take on Tarumae and Acute-san.
So count on me, okay? ☆"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fufu. That's wonderful, Tarumae-chan.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...I accept your challenge, Rickey.
But I won't let you catch up so easily.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —It's so wonderful, it makes me jealous.

Having proven herself as a locodol,
Hokko Tarumae moves on to the decisive battle.

First is the JBC Classic.
The battle with Wonder Acute
was fast approaching once again...!
